theme_and_tone.description: A premium, professional scientific tool. Avoid standard SaaS gradients. The design must feel like a precision instrument. Data is the hero. Use a clinical light theme with high-contrast text and intentional color usage strictly for data status and certainty tiers.

typography.import_instruction: Import Chivo and IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts in index.css
rules: No Inter, Roboto, or standard defaults for headings.
Use tight letter spacing for headings.
Overlines and table headers must be uppercase, tiny, with wide spacing.
Color is function only. The UI should be predominantly monochrome.
Never use full-screen gradients. Texture > Gloss.
Tint neutrals with blue to make them feel clinical (slate scale).

surface_strategies.description: Do NOT use Glassmorphism. Glass on health/science apps feels cold and obscures data. Use warm solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders.

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards to prevent data collision.
layouts_and_spacing.grid_mode: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics). Use gap-6. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3.
rtl_support_CRITICAL: NEVER use pl-, pr-, ml-, mr-, border-l-, border-r-, left-, right-.
ALWAYS use logical properties: ps-, pe-, ms-, me-, border-s-, border-e-, start-, end-.
Use text-start and text-end instead of text-left and text-right.
Use rtl:space-x-reverse with space-x classes if needed.

punnett_square.layout: Grid-based visual calculator. Top row (Parent 1 alleles), Start column (Parent 2 alleles). 2x2 inner grid for results.
punnett_square.styling: Sharp 1px borders between cells, monospace font for alleles (e.g., 'Aa'), highlight dominant traits with a subtle background tint.

certainty_badges.styling: Inline-flex, items-center, rounded-full, px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs font-semibold, using certainty_tiers colors.

disclaimer_banner.usage: Required on dashboard and calculator pages.
disclaimer_banner.styling: bg-slate-100 border-l-4 border-s-4 border-slate-500 p-4 text-sm text-slate-700

auth_background.description: A glowing white DNA double helix structure floating against a dark background.
auth_background.placement: Login/Register page split-screen background image. Add a dark overlay (bg-black/50) to ensure text readability if overlaid.

hero_texture.description: DNA double helix render on blue.
hero_texture.placement: Subtle header banner or Methods/Sources page hero section.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) on calculator cards, border color darkens.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease. NO transition-all.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='punnett-result-cell').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Large text 3:1, Normal 4.5:1. Never use transparent background under text.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make this look like a rigorous, premium scientific platform.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition-all). It breaks transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container. Keep standard block flow.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Prioritize Shadcn/UI components but heavily customize them to remove the default Vercel look.
Ensure RTL language switching flips the UI direction using dir='rtl' on the container and Tailwind logical properties.
Write .js files, NOT .tsx files as per instructions.
instructions_to_main_agent: Step 1: Set up routing and basic structure with a Language switcher (AR, EN, DE) that controls document dir='ltr' or 'rtl'.
Step 2: Build the Auth pages utilizing the auth_background image.
Step 3: Build the Dashboard layout (Sidebar/Topnav) with solid surfaces, no glass.
Step 4: Implement calculators (Punnett Square, Blood Type, Disease Risk, Height, Eye Color, Sex Probability).
Step 5: Ensure every calculator result prominently features the specified certainty tier badge, methods, assumptions, and disclaimers.
Step 6: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid.
